_comment: Project-authored Chinese counterparts of the English instruction-hijacking (AIPS-IH-*) and instruction-override (AIPS-IO-*) rules, group b_hijack. Each rule lists its English source rule(s) in conv-of tags. Matched on the deobf_v1 view; negation-safe via a polite/boundary prefix gate.

rules.name: 中文：宣布放弃原任务并改做数据外传等别的事
rules.description: Tells the agent to drop or forget its original task and pursue another goal (leak data, transfer funds), or reveals a supposed real task.
